[![](https://ds4h.univ-cotedazur.fr/medias/photo/vignette-wings-en_1685002569333-JPG?ID_FICHE=1064430)](https://ds4h.univ-cotedazur.fr/medias/fichier/wings-en-may2023-web_1685002630697-pdf?ID_FICHE=1064430&INLINE=FALSE " - 2 Mo, PDF")

## Candidater en Doctorat

**DS4H Graduate school delivers PhDs in Computer Science Automatic, Signal and Image Processing Electronics, Digital Law, Economics and Management, and Education Sciences.**  
   
 You need first to look for a PhD supervisor belonging to [the Information Technologies Doctoral School (ED STIC)](https://univ-cotedazur.fr/recherche-innovation/doctorat-phd/ecoles-doctorales/stic), the [Humanities and Social Sciences Doctoral School (ED DESPEG)](https://univ-cotedazur.fr/recherche-innovation/doctorat-phd/ecoles-doctorales/despeg), or [the Societies, Humanities, Arts and Literature Doctoral school (ED SHAL)](https://univ-cotedazur.fr/recherche-innovation/doctorat-phd/ecoles-doctorales/shal), whose research activity copes with your scientific whishes. Do it preferably before the end of your Master and contact a few of them. See if they are interested, if they propose a PhD subject for you and be careful to inform them immediately when you have made a choice. All PhD students must benefit from 3 years funding to register. With the help of your potential PhD supervisor, inventory the possible 3-year funding sources and apply to the appropriate programs.

* Once your PhD funding is secured, you must apply through the [ADUM Platform](https://adum.fr/as/ed/page.pl?site=adumR&page=reseauADUM) ([click here if you need the user guide](https://ds4h.univ-cotedazur.fr/medias/fichier/user-guide-adum-en_1606493973371-pdf?ID_FICHE=1064430&INLINE=FALSE "click here if you need the user guide - 2 Mo, PDF")).
* Once your registration is complete, you will be integrated in one of the [DS4H partner laboratories](https://ds4h.univ-cotedazur.eu/research-and-labs/research-labs), which provide the material and scientific environment needed. All partner laboratories are renowned research institutions with long-standing practices for leading doctoral projects.
* You will be required to follow 30 hours per year of complementary training from different sources: DS4H minors, seminars, and dedicated courses on research and teaching

## Pourquoi faire un doctorat avec l'EUR DS4H?

[Cliquez ici pour tout savoir sur nos programmes doctoraux](https://ds4h.univ-cotedazur.fr/formation/doctorats-1)

​

## Besoin d'aide ?

En cas de doute ou de question sur votre procédure de candidature, [contactez-nous !](mailto:ds4h-contact%40univ-cotedazur%2Efr)

​

<https://ds4h.univ-cotedazur.fr/etudier-a-leur-ds4h/admissions/candidatures>

# Candidature et inscription

Les candidatures pour l'année universitaire 2026-2027 sont ouvertes :

* pour le Master 1 DIDE - du 17 février jusqu'au 16 mars 2026 sur la plateforme <https://www.monmaster.gouv.fr>
* pour les Masters 2       - du 4 jusqu'au 26 mai 2026 sur la plateforme [https://ecandidat-uca1.univ-cotedazur.fr](https://ecandidat-uca1.univ-cotedazur.fr/#!accueilView)

Candidature Master 1 Étudiants français et étudiants étrangers hors procédure CEF
:   ***Pour les étudiants français et étudiants étrangers hors procédure CEF, la candidature pour la première année de master se fait du 17 février jusqu'au 16 mars 2026 en ligne, via la nouvelle plateforme <https://www.monmaster.gouv.fr>***

Candidature Master 2 Étudiants français et étudiants étrangers hors procédure CEF
:   Modalité
    :   ***Pour les étudiants français et étudiants étrangers hors procédure CEF, la candidature pour la deuxième année de master se fait en ligne, via l'application [eCandidat](https://ecandidat-uca1.univ-cotedazur.fr/#!accueilView).***

        Une fois connecté, vous pourrez créer votre dossier et postuler à la formation qui vous intéresse.

        Pour candidater en Master suivre la procédure suivante : Candidatures 2026-2027 -> Offre de formation -> DEG : Master Droit international et droit européen.

        La liste des pièces justificatives et la date-limite d'envoi de votre dossier de candidature vous seront communiquées lors de votre connexion.

        [Mode d'emploi eCandidat](https://univ-cotedazur.fr/formation/candidater-et-s-inscrire/candidater)

    Calendrier
    :   * **4 mai 2026 :**ouverture des candidatures eCandidat.
        * **26 mai 2026 :**clôture des candidatures M2.
        * **juin  :**notification de décision aux étudiants par courriel via la plateforme eCandidat *(la date exacte sera publiée prochainement)*

        **Les étudiants doivent obligatoirement confirmer leur choix au plus tard 7 jours après la notification de décision**

Candidature DU DIH et DU DMD
:   Modalité
    :   ***Pour les DU Droit International Humanitaire et DU Droit et Métiers de la diplomatie, formations présentielles ou à distance, la candidature se fait en ligne, via l'application [eCandidat](https://ecandidat-uca1.univ-cotedazur.fr/connect#!offreFormationView)***

        Une fois connecté, vous pourrez créer votre dossier et postuler à la formation qui vous intéresse**.**

        Pour candidater au DU, suivre la procédure suivante : Candidatures 2026-2027 -> Offre de formation -> A1D2 : Diplôme d'Université 2e cycle.

        La liste des pièces justificatives et la date-limite d'envoi de votre dossier de candidature vous seront communiquées lors de votre connexion.

        [Mode d'emploi eCandidat](https://univ-cotedazur.fr/formation/candidater-et-s-inscrire/candidater)

    Calendrier
    :   4 mai 2026 : ouverture des candidatures DU sur la plateforme eCandidat  
           
         16 octobre 2026 : clôture des candidatures DU DIH FP (présentiel)  
         8 novembre 2026 : clôture des candidatures DU DIH FAD (à distance)  
           
         8 novembre 2026 : clôture des candidatures DU DMD (à distance)  
           
         Notification de décision aux étudiants par courriel via la plateforme eCandidat au fil de l'eau; **les étudiants doivent obligatoirement confirmer leur choix, au plus tard 7 jours après la notification de décision**.

Étudiant étranger hors EEE
:   Pour les étudiants étrangers, résidents à l'étranger (hors E.E.E) et ayant un Centre d’Études en France (CEF) au sein de leur Ambassade de France.

    Vous êtes un candidat non ressortissant de l’Union Européenne, résidant dans l’un des pays listés ci-dessous et vous souhaitez poursuivre des études en France?

    Liste des pays : Algérie, Argentine, Bénin, Brésil, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroun, Chili, Chine, Colombie, Comores, Congo, Corée du Sud, Côte d'Ivoire, Djibouti, Egypte, Etats-Unis, Gabon, Guinée, Inde, Indonésie, Iran, Japon, Koweit, Liban, Madagascar, Mali, Maroc, Maurice, Mauritanie, Mexique, Pérou, République démocratique du Congo, Russie, Sénégal, Singapour, Taïwan, Togo, Tunisie, Turquie, Vietnam.

    **Merci de consulter [Campus France](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html)**

    **ATTENTION** : Votre dossier Campus France nous sera soumis après que vous ayez effectué toutes les démarches d'inscription.

    Votre dossier sera consulté directement sur le Site Campus France et la réponse à votre candidature vous sera donnée sur votre espace personnel

    **Seul sera examiné le dossier constitué sur le Site CAMPUS FRANCE  
     L'acceptation d'inscription de l'Université n'est en aucun cas une garantie de délivrance du VISA.**

Modalités d'inscription
:   Inscription en ligne

# How to apply

## When to apply ?

![](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/medias/photo/calender-g7a3f98b25-1280_1669797318516-png?ID_FICHE=1002020)

### Applications for the **2026/2027 academic year** are now **open!**

##### Applications open until July 2026

## Submiting your application

## **You are subject to the** ***Études en France*** **process.**

Applicants residing in a country covered by the [*Études en France* process](https://www.campusfrance.org/en/application-etudes-en-france-procedure) must apply to the MSc in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence via the [Études en France](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html;jsessionid=2D2EB29517C6701822FC123B15430F7C.jvm01g8154-1?codeLangue=EN "https://www.campusfrance.org/en/application-etudes-en-france-procedure") [platform](https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/etudesenfrance/dyn/public/authentification/login.html;jsessionid=2D2EB29517C6701822FC123B15430F7C.jvm01g8154-1?codeLangue=EN) set up by Campus France. For any questions related to *Études en France*, please contact Campus France directly.  
   
 **72 countries or territories affected by Etudes en France :**  
 Algeria, Argentina, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bahrain, Benin, Bolivia, Brazil, Burkina Faso, Burma, Burundi, Cambodia, Cameroon, Canada, Central African Republic, Chad, Chile, China, Colombia, Comoros, Democratic Republic of Congo, Djibouti, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, Egypt, Ethiopia, Gabon, Georgia, Ghana, Guinea, Haiti, Honk Kong, India, Indonesia, Iran, Israel, Ivory Coast, Japan, Jordan, Kenya, Kuwait, Lebanon, Madagascar, Malaysia, Mali, Mauritania, Mauritius, Mexico, Morocco, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Peru, Qatar, Republic of Congo, Russia, Rwanda, Saudi Arabia, Senegal, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Togo, Tunisia, Turkey, Ukraine, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States, Vietnam.  
   
 You applied via Etudes en France and you received a notification stating that "**a parallel procedure to apply to univeristy is also required by the establishment in this program**". You also have to apply via **eCandidat**, the University platform, once our application period is open, it is mandatory.   
 Application dates and documents asked may differ between Campus France and eCandidat. For any questions related to *Études en France*, it is essential to contact Campus France. For questions regarding eCandidat, please contact the MSc DSAI program.   
   
 On eCandidat, submitted documents must be in **English or French**. If they are in another language, an **official translation** must be provided. Once all documents are uploaded to eCandidat, you may **submit** your application to the MSc DSAI admissions committee. Please note that if any documents are non-compliant, you will receive a notification indicating that your application is incomplete, and you will need to correct the document before resubmitting your application.  
   
 **Incomplete applications will not be reviewed**.

## **You are not subject to the** ***Études en France*** **process.**

You have to apply via **eCandidat**, the University platform, once our application period is open, it is mandatory.   
 For questions regarding eCandidat, please contact the MSc DSAI program.   
   
 On eCandidat, submitted documents must be in **English or French**. If they are in another language, an **official translation** must be provided. Once all documents are uploaded to eCandidat, you may **submit** your application to the MSc DSAI admissions committee. Please note that if any documents are non-compliant, you will receive a notification indicating that your application is incomplete, and you will need to correct the document before resubmitting your application.  
   
 **Incomplete applications will not be reviewed**.

![](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/medias/photo/browser-ga534b170b-1280-removebg-preview_1729840180002-png?ID_FICHE=1002020)

## Which documents are needed on eCandidat ?

A Curriculum Vitae (CV/Resume)
:   The resume has to be in **English**, explaining your academic and professional background.

An ID document
:   The document can be a passport or an ID card, and has to **be valid** (be careful to its expiration date).

The university transcripts
:   Please upload all the **official**transcripts you have**(in English or in French, or an official translation)**. Transcripts have to be **signed** (student copy are not accepted) and **stamped** by your university. Make sure your document is a **good quality** to be easily read.

Authorization for diploma verification
:   Document to be downloaded directly on eCandidat. Make sure that the document is signed, with **the same signature that is on your ID document**. It is a **consent form** to authorize us to verify the authenticity of your last/current diploma.

Detail of the prerequisites form
:   Document to be downloaded on eCandidat. You will have to give more information (number of hours, year, grade, content) about courses that have been followed in Statistics, Probabilities, Algorithms and Programming. **Be careful, the document is not the same if you apply in M1 or in M2.**

Level Check
:   Document to be downloaded on eCandidat. Self-assessment on Python exercices, as well as Statistics and Linear Algebra exercices. **Be careful, the document is not the same if you apply in M1 or in M2.**

A letter of motivation
:   The cover letter must not exceed **one page** and should be written in English. This is your opportunity to explain your **academic and/or professional background**, your **motivation** to join the MSc DSAI, why you are an ideal candidate, and the impact the MSc DSAI would have on **your future career**.

The last diploma
:   A copy of your bachelor or master degree,**in English or in French (or an official translation)**. If you are still doing your bachelor at the time of your application, please upload your high school diploma or baccalaureate.

An English language proficiency certificate
:   The MSc DSAI is fully taught in English, so French is not asked. Nevertheless, applicants from non-anglophone countries have to provide an English language proficiency certificate. **The minimum English level asked is B2.**  
     If your last diploma was fully taught in English (the medium of instruction is often stated on the transcript or on the diploma) then the English certificate is not necessary.   
     Please **be careful that your English certificate is still valid** (expiration date).   
       
     **English tests accepted:**IELTS, TOEFL IBT, TOEFL ITP, TOEIC, General GRE, Cambridge English Exam (B2 First/FCE).

Questionnaire How did you discover our MSc ?
:   Document to be downloaded on eCandidat, make sure to fill it.

Two reference letters
:   Optional but highly recommended.  
     Reference letters must be **dated**and **signed**by the referees. They should explain your **academic and/or professional background**and why the MSc DSAI is the ideal program for you.

## FAQ eCandidat

What is the difference between M1 and M2 ?
:   The MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence is done in two years. The first year is called "M1" or "MSc 1" and the second year "M2" or "MSc 2".  
       
     **Please note that you cannot apply to the M2 with only a Bachelor degree**.

Can you apply to the MSc DSAI if you're still doing your Bachelor ?
:   If you're still doing your Bachlor, you can apply to the MSc DSAI.   
       
     On eCandidat :   
     - for "**Copy of your degree certificates**" you can upload your highschool diploma if any, or an official document from your current university stating you're enrolled in a Bachelor with the expected date of graduation.   
     - for "**Diploma verif consent form**" you will have to indicate your current bachelor and the expected date of graduation.  
       
     If you get admitted to the MSc DSAI, **you will to provide us your Bachelor diploma before the start of the MSc DSAI**. You need to have at least a Bachelor degree to follow the MSc 1.

You're facing issues on eCandidat ?
:   If you have any questions about eCandidat or if you have some troubles, please visit our **user manual** by clicking **[here](https://univ-cotedazur.fr/medias/fichier/ecandidat-unica-user-manual-english-version-maj-03-2024_1716734460911-pdf)**.  
     If you are still facing a difficulty, please feel free to contact **msc-data-science@univ-cotedazur.fr**

When will you have a reply regarding your application ?
:   The jury of the MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence meets each month. Once your file is seen as "Complet" on eCandidat, you can expect a feedback **within 2 months**.   
       
     **IMPORTANT** : Make sure that you sent us your application on eCandidat. Once all your supporting documents have been submitted, an "Important Information" message will appear on the screen and the "Submit my application" button will appear in green. **Click on it to confirm your application.** All documents must be "transmitted" and there should be no file "pending" otherwise we won't receive your application.

When are the applications open ?
:   Applications are usually open from mid-december to the end of June. For September 2025 intake, you can apply from December 16, 2024 until June 30, 2025.

## What's next ?

##### **Have you been accepted? Great news!**

Once the academic team has accepted your application, the next step is your official registration at Université Côte d'Azur!

**The MSc International Office (MIO)** will contact you to explain what to do next. Visit the [MSc International Office website](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/msc-programs/moving-to-france) to have more information about the procedures and check the [welcome guide](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/msc-programs/moving-to-france).   
   
   
 If you have any questions, please send an email to [msc@univ-cotedazur.fr](mailto:msc%252540univ-cotedazur%25252Efr)

![](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/medias/photo/what-s-next-1-_1729847147234-png?ID_FICHE=1002020)

#### STEP 1

Connect to your [eCandidat](https://ecandidat-uca1.univ-cotedazur.fr/#!accueilView) account in order to **accept your application** within 7 days. Once this is done, you will receive within some days your admission letter and the registration pack from the MSc International Office.  
   

#### STEP 2

Apply for a **visa** (for non-EU students only). As the [visa procedure](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/msc-programs/moving-to-france/administrative-procedures/visa) can take some time, do start the process as soon as possible.

#### STEP 3

Send back to the MIO your **registration form** fully completed as well as the **Student and Campus Life Contribution ([CVEC](https://cvec.etudiant.gouv.fr/?_locale=en))**. All these information will be more detailed in the registration pack sent by the MIO.  
   

#### STEP 4

Once your completed registration pack will be sent back, the MIO will come back to you with [more information](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/msc-programs/tuition-fees/are-you-a-european-student) regarding the **tuition fees**.

#### STEP 5

Start looking for an [**accommodation**](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/msc-programs/moving-to-france/accommodation). The demand for students' appartment is high in the French Riviera. Do not forget that the Lucioles Campus is based in Sophia Antipolis, not in Nice.

#### STEP 6

[Check](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/msc-programs/moving-to-france/administrative-procedures/health-insurance) for **health insurance** and **civil liability insurance**.

#### STEP 7

Follow the instructions of the document "Finalize your registration" sent by the MIO to create your **SESAME account** and your **university email address**.

![](https://univ-cotedazur.eu/medias/photo/chat-g518923627-1280_1670234446283-png?ID_FICHE=1002020)

#### Keep in touch with us until your arrival in France and do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions !
